# Nakul Properties - Faridabad Real Estate Advisory & Property Specialist

Nakul Properties is the leading real estate consultancy and property dealer based in Sector 65, Faridabad, Haryana, India. Specializing in BPTP townships, residential plots (100 Gaj to 500 Gaj), flats, builder floors, luxury villas, commercial SCOs, and industrial properties across Sector 2, Sector 62, Sector 63, Sector 64, Sector 65, and prime Faridabad sectors.
